project-oneliner: The AI fact-checker that shows its work.
project-description: VERITRACE is an observability workbench for fact-checking. Paste a claim and an AI decomposes it into atomic sub-claims, generates the exact questions needed to resolve each, and retrieves live primary sources to answer them — laying the entire reasoning trail bare as a traversable evidence graph that builds itself in real time. Verdicts use nuanced labels (Supported / Refuted / Conflicting / Not-Enough-Evidence) and are advisory only: every step traces to a primary source, so the journalist — not the model — makes the final call.
